why: Only rounds 1, 2, 3, 5 and 7 of this bundle are 413's review. Rounds 4, 6 and 8 belong to a sibling feature (census groups, Song, osaka-1620), and the bundle's request.md is issue #15 from specs/414-price-stability, so I set them aside as contamination. 413's first pass ended FAITHFUL at round 3. The GM then withdrew the 25-year default, which opened a new pass: round 5 found the withdrawn number put back in US4, round 7 confirmed that fix and raised two NEW wording findings, and nothing reversed or oscillated. So this was round 2 of a new pass, not a cap, and the fixes converge. The two remaining findings are wording, and the reviewer supplied the replacement text nearly word for word, so another round would only re-read two sentences that are already written. No packing: the 25-year number was withdrawn by the GM, and the spec now leaves closeness to the author's judgment, pending diagram#15.
what: The spec stands as round 7 left it, plus the two wording edits now in the working tree: plan D6's example reason in the new form ('Edo 1804-30; the author judges no built era close enough to borrow, pending diagram#15'), and US4 scenario 1's clause narrowed so that only a no-close-era pass-over must state the amount's date (for a * line, the years its block names) and the author's judgment. Nothing is left to file.
tooling_fix: make arbiter-bundle: take the feature directory, spec.md, request.md and the rounds only from specs/<the trigger id's feature>/ and refuse any transcript or file from another specs/ directory. This bundle, built for 413-money-tooltip-on-the-record, resolved to specs/414-price-stability (no spec.md, issue #15's request.md) and mixed a sibling's rounds 4, 6 and 8 in with 413's. Test: rebuilding this trigger's bundle yields 413's spec.md and request.md and only its five rounds. Measured cost: this arbiter dispatch, fired at a false round cap, plus the reconstruction that rounds 5 and 7 each had to open with.
gm_words: Please file A through F as one feature. after we have cleared the backlog, then there will still be the three GM review items that are genuinely mine open, which is exactly what we want. And then I will handle them on my own time as appropriate. Thank you.
